"Qingfeng, if someone sends them there, just say it's the king's wish."
Qing Ling and Qing Yin couldn't react, but they had been taught for ten years to be loyal to King Jin and must obey any orders from King Jin. Although they were confused, they bowed and retreated, preparing to go to the Lu Mansion.
Prince Jin got off the carriage, folded his hands behind his back, and looked up at the words "Prince Jin's Palace" on the door plaque, his eyes unclear.
The housekeeper and Aunt Qing both looked at his legs with fear.
"As always, it doesn't hurt to take a few steps slower." King Jin stepped into the gate.
The housekeeper and Aunt Qing looked at each other, sighed at the same time, and hurried in.
Aunt Qing resisted the urge to help King Jin and looked at him distressedly. She had brought up King Jin, and she felt most distressed.
"Your Majesty, Qing Ling and Qing Yin are sensible, obedient, and diligent. I think you have no one in your room and you have to have someone to take care of you. Why did you send them out? Is there anything wrong with the second lady of the Lu family?"
Aunt Qing thought something was wrong with Miss Lu Er. Prince Jin wanted Qingling Qingyin to keep an eye on her, and she didn't dare to think about anything else.
For this kind of errand, just send someone else to do it. Qingling Qingyin was specially trained and taught by her for the prince. She also hoped that the two maids could become the prince's roommates.
What's wrong? There is something wrong with that girl.
"Miss Lu Er is my fiancée," he said.
"What did the prince say? Cough cough cough!" Aunt Qing was so shocked that she coughed violently.
"Fiancée?!" The housekeeper quacked like an old duck whose neck was being strangled.
When did the prince have a fiancée? How come they don't know?
King Jin thought of what he had just experienced, and the corners of his lips couldn't help but rise. He looked down at his clothes, and his Adam's apple rolled when he thought of the scene where Lu Zhaoling's hands decisively pulled off his clothes.
Grandma Qing even wanted to cover her heart. The stimulation was too great and sudden, and she couldn't bear it!
"Your Majesty, didn't you say that the whole city is disgusting with vulgar powder?" The housekeeper almost stuttered.
The Queen Mother has never given up for so many years. She has wanted to grant marriage to the princes several times, but she said that one of them was disliked by the prince. Now that the prince is twenty, seeing that the candidate for Princess Jin is still hopeless, suddenly she has a new fiancée?
"Well, I met someone who is not so vulgar." King Jin sat down.
"Is this the second young lady of the Lu family?" Nanny Qing's eyes shone, "The prince has fallen in love with her?"
"She fell in love with me and asked to marry him," he said.
Aunt Qing covered her racing heart and said, "Is it from Lord Lu Minglu's house? I have met the three young ladies in his family, and my impression is very average."
Moreover, except for the eldest lady, the other two are concubines. The concubine of a Lu family wants to be the princess of Jin? This identity is too different!
"That is the concubine of the Lu family. She is very angry when she sees the young family. Your Majesty—" Aunt Qing was about to cry, "Do you want to stop thinking about it?"
